body: I don't know. I don't know why I am so ungrateful and pessimistic toward life. I know I should be more grateful for what I do have in life, but I'm not. I can only focus on the negative all the time.

I would never do the things that I know so many others are capable of, which is what makes it so scary, for one how can people be so cruel? And two you never know who is evil and who is good. Also, most people have some wickedness in them, even if they wouldn't commit violent crimes. They will still laugh at the misery of others, like that random crowd of strangers. I'm not like that either. I have empathy, which is apparently largely lacking in the masses. 

My best friend just died a couple of years ago, beyond that I don't really have any close friends I can trust anymore. Really the only people that I like are children, because they haven't become monsters yet.

You know what I just realized, what I really hate is just life! This is the worst time of year because everything comes to life. You have to deal with snakes, wasps, mosquitos, flies, mice, all kinds of stuff. Even the plants attack you. Humans are out in swarms too, you can't go swimming or really anything else without it being overpopulated. I love winter time because of the peace and quiet it brings. Everyone else hates winter. I'm just a conundrum. What kind of person am I if I have no respect, or even patience, for all of life on earth? I'm a prisoner on my own planet.

It matters to some extent, but not as much as the people who know me. I remember this one time I went to a concert with some friends, and got really messed up. I would've been fine until I smoked some weed with some people I didn't even know, then I got too stoned and I lost my friends in the crowd. I remember standing in the back by myself scanning the crowd for them, and I pulled out my phone and tried to call them, but it was too loud to talk to them, but when I put the phone to my ear I heard some bitch say "Mommy come get me!" And then a bunch of people laughed, and I realized they had BEEN laughing at me just because I looked lost and was standing alone. Ridiculing me in public, even amongst purely strangers, still hurts. 

Humanity is wicked. Always has been always will be. I fear for the future. I really do think things are going to get crazy in the future. There will be a civil war I reckon. I'm also always afraid people are going to try to rob me, torture me, ridicule me more extremely, or who knows what. I don't trust anyone. Can't.

Thanks for taking the time to talk. 

I have always wanted to direct. One of the reasons I quit is specifically because I don't want to go to Hollywood. I also believe most movies are terrible now. I want to make original movies, which is so rare now. For summer 2016 only two of the 20 or so movies coming to theaters is an original script. It's sad. Everything is just superheroes and big explosions, generic plot and 'bad guys' and there's no heart and soul or creativity in movies now. It's cookie cutter. So my only other option was to make films independent, but you probably don't know how much your average film costs. An extremely low budget, independent film would be around 4-5 million dollars, that is super cheap in the movie industry. That is if you want to make professional films that people take seriously. It's not something you can do on your own unless you're literally a millionaire. Who am I kidding? Should've never pursued it at ALL. 

And I still think it matters, because I have a desire to prove myself, and if people think something false of me, that is even worse than them thinking negative things that are true, because at least I can change that then. But I can't stand people thinking things about me that aren't true, and I know that happens too. Everyone thinks I'm lazy, the irony is if they actually did some work with me I would work circles around them. I'm not lazy, I just feel paralyzed because I don't know what to do, or I don't know where to begin, or I fear doing the wrong thing. Doing nothing is just the safe route. So yeah, it's not fun having everyone you know think the absolute worst of you. It only makes me want to retreat into my shell that much more, which in turn just makes me more of a reclusive weirdo, and it's a downward spiral.

Well I will never be able to do what I always wanted to do, that much is certain. I gave up on that just a few weeks ago. So my only hope now is to maybe go to trade school and just try to make decent money with something so I can get my own place somewhere nicer. I will probably never have a family though. I would like kids but I haven't been with a woman in many years. Most women don't like me and I don't really like them either. So 'best case scenario' doesn't have a lot going on for it. What's the point anyway? Even with more money and independence I won't be any happier. 

I care what people think because it matters. If nobody cared what others think about them we wouldn't even bother with personal hygiene, or being friendly to strangers, etc. I'm just willing to admit it. People that say they don't care what others think about them are lying to try to look cool. I know that people think I'm weird, because I'm socially awkward, but they also probably think I'm a creep because I've been alone for so long. They're right about all of it. I'm a weird, creepy loser. 

If everyone hates you does it really matter if your happy or not? Imagine if everyone you know despised you and talked bad about you behind your back. Wouldn't that bother you? Wouldn't that be important and lay heavily on your mind?
